children: Dragonfly Energy's revenue fell 23.8% year over year, while net loss narrowed to $5.5 million from $11.1 million, primarily as lower selling and marketing expenses and reduced interest expense offset lower sales. Sales declined amid lower OEM and DTC volumes, with RV OEM demand affected by a slower-than-anticipated recovery and macroeconomic conditions.
¹ Reported as “Net Sales”. ² Reported as “Net Loss Attributable to Common Stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Loss Per Share- Basic & Diluted”.
: DTC sales were $4.8 million and OEM sales were $7.1 million, versus $5.0 million and $10.7 million a year earlier.
: Gross profit margin fell 2.7 percentage points to 27.0%, primarily due to lower unit sales volume.
: The company reported a significant increase in trucking revenue as the market continued to develop; Stevens Transport committed to use its solutions on every new truck for 2027 and 2028.
: Acquired the brand's operating assets on July 31; the company expects material revenue contribution beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026.
